items.title: FAA issues ‘ground stop’ for all flights across the U.S. due to safety issue. Live updates here.
items.author: CTVNews.ca Staff
items.summary: The FAA issued the ground stop after a 'communication issue' impacting all U.S. Air Route Traffic Control Centers,' U.S. Transport Secretary Sean Duffy said in a social media post.
items.body: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration says flight departures can resume after the agency lifted a nationwide ground stop that cancelled or suspended thousands of flights around the world on Friday. Canada’s major airlines confirmed flights heading to and from the U.S. are cancelled. Air Canada said some flights to non-U.S. destinations like the Caribbean and South America may also be impacted. Transport Minister Steven MacKinnon said Canada is ready to provide “full assistance” to the FAA as delays continue into the evening. This is just the second nationwide ground stop in the United States since the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks. Follow for key updates:

items.title: US flight cancellations: Air India issues advisory amid outage; here’s how you can check if your flight is impacted
items.author: Swati Gandhi
items.summary: Air India has issued a travel advisory amid widespread flight disruptions across the US following a communications outage. Passengers travelling to and from the country have been advised to check their flight status online before heading to the airport.
items.body: Air India on Saturday issued a travel advisory following widespread flight disruptions across the United States due to a communications outage. The airline advised passengers to check the status of their flights departing from or arriving at airports across the country.In a social media post, the Indian carrier wrote, "A nationwide ground stop is currently in effect across the US due to communication outages affecting air traffic operations. As a result, departures from airports across the U.S. are impacted, with possible consequential disruptions to Air India flights to and from the U.S. Passengers are advised to check the latest status of their flights and plan their journey to the airport accordingly."It added, “Our teams continue to closely monitor the situation and will share updates as available.”Why are airports across the US seeing disruptions?On Friday (local time), US authorities halted flights nationwide for the longest period since the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks, highlighting vulnerabilities in the country's air traffic control system, Bloomberg reported.The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced a ground stop covering airports across the country in an advisory posted on its website on Friday afternoon. It stated that all departing traffic would remain halted until further notice. The agency later attributed the disruption to a temporary telecommunications outage.The FAA said, "Every flight has been accounted for, and international flights will be handled on a case-by-case basis." Although a handful of international flights were allowed to depart a few hours after the grounding began, passengers were left stranded at airports across the country, roughly two weeks ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday, with little clarity on when normal operations would resume.According to reports, the latest incident marks the third nationwide ground stop in US history, following a 2023 disruption involving the FAA's safety notification system for pilots and dispatchers and the September 11 terrorist attacks in 2001.With flight operations affected across the country, passengers travelling to or from the US may want to check whether their scheduled flights have been delayed or cancelled. Here's how to check your flight status online.How to check online if your flight is affectedHere is a step-by-step guide to checking whether your flight has been affected by the outage:1. Visit Air India's official website: www.airindia.com.2. Click on the 'Book and Manage' option on the homepage.3. Select 'Flight Status' from the drop-down menu.4. Enter your details. You can use your flight number, PNR, or route, along with your travel date.5. Click on 'Get Flight Status' to view the latest updates.Alternatively, you can visit Air India's Flight Status page (https://www.airindia.com/in/en/manage/flight-status.html) directly to check your flight details.

items.title: サッカー＝メッシ引退のアルゼンチン、ウルグアイに敗戦　国際親善試合
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１３日　ロイター］ - サッカーの国際親善試合が１３日に各地で行われ、アルゼンチンはホームでウルグアイに１─２で敗れた。

リオネル・メッシの代表引退後初の試合を迎えたアルゼンチンだが、後半３分にオウンゴールで先制を許すと、同８分にも失点。後半２８分にはジャンルカ・プレスティアンニのアシストからフリアン・アルバレスのゴールで１点を返すも、そのまま敗れた。

アルゼンチンはこの後、１７日の国際親善試合でコスタリカをホームに迎える。

サウジアラビアはカタールの首都ドーハで韓国と対戦し、３─２で勝利。オーストラリアはアウェーでカタールに３─０で快勝した。

items.title: US Loses Measles Elimination Status as Cases Surge, WSJ Says
items.author: list.metadata.agency
items.summary: The US has lost its long-standing status as having eradicated measles after transmission of the disease has continued through the past year and broken case records, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing unidentified people familiar with the matter.
items.body: (Bloomberg) -- The US has lost its long-standing status as having eradicated measles after transmission of the disease has continued through the past year and broken case records, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing unidentified people familiar with the matter.The report followed a review of the evidence by the Pan American Health Organization, which verifies nations’ elimination status. PAHO and the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention weren’t immediately available to comment after normal business hours on Friday.PAHO evaluates whether a single strain of measles virus has been circulating in a community for 12 months. Utah’s outbreak — which has infected more than 700 people — met the criteria and cost the US its status. While the loss of the status is just a label, it does represent a national failure to control the highly contagious disease. It’s also likely to prompt warnings about travel to the US and vaccine advisories from other nations.Canada lost its status a year ago. To regain it, the countries must prove continuous transmission has stopped and that surveillance systems to track the disease have been strengthened. The US officially eliminated measles in 2000 following a public communications push. But vaccination rates declined as the pandemic increased distrust in federal health guidance, creating an opportunity for the virus to take hold again. The CDC has confirmed 5,412 cases so far in 2026, more than double last year’s total and the highest number recorded since 1991. Under Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the CDC has been upended by staff departures and leadership changes. About a third of the career staff were forced out or voluntarily left following cuts from Elon Musk’s so-called Department of Government Efficiency. The public health agency has also been overwhelmed with responding to other outbreaks, including Ebola and cyclosporiasis. In August, CDC Director Erica Schwartz became the agency’s first permanent director in almost a year. Continuous SpreadPennsylvania has seen the largest outbreak in the US this year, recording more than 1,500 cases since it began in April and reporting its seventh measles-related death on Friday. A total of nine people in the US have died from measles so far this year — three times the toll in 2025. The CDC has only recognized six of these deaths following a feud with Pennsylvania over how they were classified.But it was Utah’s cases that led to the loss of elimination status. The state’s outbreak began in June 2025 and has continued to grow. Its public health experts say the virus has likely infected more people than what’s been recorded by local health departments. Only 87.2% of Utah kindergartners were inoculated with the MMR vaccine in the 2025-2026 school year, according to the CDC. Kennedy, who previously led an anti-vaccine organization and said getting the measles, mumps and rubella shot should be a “personal choice,” has upended US inoculation policy alongside President Donald Trump. Trump issued an executive order earlier this year directing HHS to produce a report on how to split up the MMR vaccine into separate components, which could make it more time-consuming for Americans to get all three. It would also mean complicated and expensive retoolings for manufacturers Merck & Co. and GSK Plc. While no vaccine is perfect, the MMR vaccine is 97% effective in preventing disease after two doses, according to the CDC. Measles is highly contagious, infecting up to 90% of unvaccinated people exposed to the disease. People experience flu-like symptoms and a red rash all over the body, sometimes leading to complications including encephalitis, pneumonia and even death. --With assistance from Andrea Navarro and Andrea Chang.(Updates with additional details beginning in the fifth paragraph.)More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

items.title: テニス＝スビトリナがサバレンカ破り4強、ＷＴＡファイナル
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１３日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［１３日　ロイター］　 - 女子テニスのシーズン最終戦、ＷＴＡファイナルは１３日、米カリフォルニア州インディアンウェルズでシングルスの１次リーグ最終戦を行い、２組では第６シードのエリナ・スビトリナ（ウクライナ）が第２シードでベラルーシ出身のアリーナ・サバレンカを破り、準決勝進出を決めた。

スビトリナは第１セットの第１ゲームでブレークを許したものの、ブレークバックに成功。さらに相手のサービスゲームを破って逆転し、６─３で先取した。第２セットはサバレンカがサービスブレークで主導権を握り、６─３で取り返して勝負を最終セットに持ち込んだ。

スビトリナは最終セットでサバレンカのサービスゲームを３度ブレークし、６─１で１時間５３分の熱戦を制した。サバレンカ戦では２０２０年以来６年ぶりの白星で、連敗を５で止めた。

スビトリナは１次リーグを２勝１敗の同組２位で通過し、２０１９年以来の準決勝進出。一方、サバレンカは１勝２敗で敗退となった。

すでに同組１位での４強入りを決めていた第３シードでロシア出身のミラ・アンドレエワは、同じくロシア出身のディアナ・シュナイデルに６─２、６─１で快勝。５５分でストレート勝ちを収め、１次リーグを３連勝で終えた。シュナイデルは体調不良のため欠場したカロリナ・ムホバ（チェコ）に代わって出場した。

準決勝ではスビトリナがリンダ・ノスコバ（チェコ）、アンドレエワがジェシカ・ペグラ（米国）と対戦する。

items.title: EE.UU. levanta suspensión de vuelos tras más de cuatro horas de paralización por una falla técnica
items.author: Will Guisbond, Sri Taylor, Courtney Subramanian
items.summary: La suspensión de vuelos a nivel nacional, la tercera en la historia de Estados Unidos, se produjo mientras la FAA lidia con la obsolescencia de su infraestructura de control de tráfico aéreo y la crec ...
items.body: Bloomberg — La Administración Federal de Aviación (FAA) canceló la suspensión de vuelos a nivel nacional tras una interrupción en las telecomunicaciones que paralizó las salidas de vuelos en todo Estados Unidos, según un aviso en su sitio web, lo que permitió a las aerolíneas reanudar sus operaciones después de más de cuatro horas. La suspensión de operaciones en tierra se levantó a las 20:15 del viernes por la noche, luego de que la falla en las comunicaciones afectara a los centros de control de tráfico aéreo en todo el país. Las aerolíneas ahora se enfrentan al reto de restablecer sus horarios tras la interrupción, con retrasos y cancelaciones que podrían extenderse por todo el sistema de aviación durante horas mientras las compañías aéreas trabajan para que los aviones y las tripulaciones vuelvan a sus puestos. Ver más: FBI investiga si una actualización de software causó la falla que afectó al tráfico aéreo en EE.UU. “Nuestros conmutadores y enrutadores se sobrecargaron de datos y dejaron de funcionar”, declaró el secretario de Transporte, Sean Duffy, en una rueda de prensa. “En realidad, no debería decir que dejaron de funcionar. Empezaron a presentar inconsistencias en los datos que recibían de esos enrutadores. Por eso, tuvimos que desconectar el sistema”. La inusual suspensión de vuelos a nivel nacional, la tercera en la historia de Estados Unidos, se produjo mientras la FAA lidia con la obsolescencia de su infraestructura de control de tráfico aéreo y la creciente presión para modernizar sus sistemas. La agencia había ordenado inicialmente que todos los vuelos con salida permanecieran en tierra hasta nuevo aviso, alegando circunstancias extraordinarias y preocupaciones de seguridad. “Nos llevará algún tiempo deshacer lo sucedido esta tarde”, añadió Duffy. Duffy declaró el viernes que el problema de comunicaciones afectó a todos los centros de control de tráfico aéreo, que gestionan las aeronaves que vuelan a gran altitud. La FAA atribuyó la interrupción a un fallo temporal en las telecomunicaciones, aunque la causa exacta sigue bajo investigación. “Teníamos más de 3.500 aviones en el aire”, dijo Duffy en una conferencia de prensa. “Todos participaron en la maniobra, y la última vez que revisé, teníamos menos de 400 en el espacio aéreo, ya que todos se dirigían a aterrizar de forma segura, y lo gestionamos con nuestros procedimientos habituales para este tipo de incidentes”. Según una persona familiarizada con el asunto, el FBI no cree que la interrupción del servicio haya sido causada por un ciberataque o actividad delictiva. Los investigadores están analizando si una actualización de software pudo haber provocado la interrupción, añadió la misma fuente. Ver más: Qué pasó con los aeropuertos y vuelos en Estados Unidos hoy, 13 de noviembre Este cierre supuso la tercera interrupción a nivel nacional de las operaciones en tierra en la historia de Estados Unidos, tras la interrupción en 2023 del sistema de notificación de seguridad de la FAA para pilotos y despachadores y los atentados terroristas del 11 de septiembre de 2001. Esta interrupción se produce mientras la FAA emprende una modernización integral de su anticuada infraestructura de control de tráfico aéreo, respaldada por US$12.500 millones de financiación del Congreso. Duffy ha solicitado US$30.000 millones adicionales para este proyecto, y el Departamento de Transporte renovó dicha solicitud esta semana. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: トランプ氏、中国で中ロ首脳と核軍縮協議へ＝ホワイトハウス
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン １３日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン １３日　ロイター] - ホワイトハウス報道官は１３日、トランプ米大統領が来週の訪中の最後にロシアのプーチン大統領、中国の習近平国家主席と会談すると明らかにした。トランプ氏は会談で核兵器の削減について協議するという。

ただ、米当局者は「何らかの合意に至るとは見込んでいない」と述べた。

これに先立ち、米紙ニューヨーク・ポストは１３日、トランプ氏が１９日に、中国・深センで開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせ、プーチン氏と習氏と３カ国首脳会談を行うと報じていた。

これとは別に、米当局者は１３日、トランプ氏は訪中の際に、米情報機関が中国のスパイと疑っているアリス・フアン氏の問題を取り上げるつもりはないと述べた。フアン氏は米エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と不倫関係にあったとされる。

items.title: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang misled top lawyer on affair with Alice Huang, sources say
items.author: The Straits Times
items.summary: Huang described his relations with Alice Huang as typical for customer interactions.
items.body:
Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang misled top lawyer on affair with Alice Huang, sources say
Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox

Jensen Huang apologised in a statement on Nov 8 for being unfaithful to his wife and for disappointing the company.
PHOTO: REUTERS

Published   Nov 14, 2026, 09:25 AM

Updated   Nov 14, 2026, 09:25 AM

Set as preferred source

Summarise

Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO after admitting an affair and apologising for being unfaithful to his wife and disappointing the company.
Reuters says he misled Nvidia leaders, including Tim Teter and Alison Wagonfeld, by calling his ties with Alice Huang and Megaspeed “standard business dealings”.
Nvidia hired Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz for an independent probe, while the scandal and China spying claims have helped push Nvidia shares down more than 30%.

AI generated

SAN FRANCISCO - Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang misled several of the company’s leaders, including general counsel Tim Teter and chief marketing officer Alison Wagonfeld, about the nature of his relationship with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, with whom he had an affair, according to two people familiar with the matter and internal correspondence reviewed by Reuters.
Reuters reviewed several exchanges from October on condition of not quoting verbatim from the messages. The news agency is the first to report on this correspondence.
On Nov 12, Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO, a spectacular fall from the chip industry’s heights where he was a pioneer of technology central to the recent boom in artificial intelligence.

He apologised in a statement on Nov 8 for being unfaithful to his wife and for disappointing the company. His statement did not specifically name Alice Huang, a former top executive of Nvidia customer Megaspeed International, whom the US was investigating for potentially spying for China. Jensen Huang and Alice Huang share a last name but are not related.
The New York Times earlier this week reported Huang also had an extramarital relationship with an Nvidia employee, and Reuters reported on Nov 12 that Huang had another intimate relationship with a different Nvidia employee.

Teter did not respond to a request for comment. Wagonfeld did not immediately respond to a request for comment. A representative for ex-CEO Huang and an Nvidia spokesperson declined to comment. A phone call and e-mail to contact information listed on a business card for Alice Huang went unanswered.

During the autumn of 2025 and in October 2026, in response to press queries that drew some Nvidia leaders’ attention to his relationship with Megaspeed and Alice Huang, Huang at both times described their interactions as appropriate, the people said, speaking on the condition of anonymity. Reuters only reviewed messages from the exchanges in October, not the ones from 2025.
In two separate messages in October, Huang told Nvidia leaders, including Teter and Wagonfeld, that the interactions reflected standard business dealings with customers. In other messages, Huang affirmed the routine nature of his interactions with Megaspeed.
Nvidia’s Huang also discussed taking legal action against the New York Times after it published an article in October 2025 that drew attention to his meetings in public with Alice Huang, the people said.

That article had prompted Jensen Huang to communicate with some Nvidia leaders in 2025 about their interactions, which he did not describe as an affair, the people said. Ultimately, neither Nvidia nor Huang filed a lawsuit against the paper. A spokesperson for the New York Times said the paper received no legal demand.
It is unclear when his relationship with Alice Huang became intimate. Photos posted online and verified by Reuters show them together in the US, China and elsewhere, dating as far back as December 2023.
On Nov 10, the independent members of Nvidia’s board said they hired Wall Street law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to conduct an independent investigation after the New York Times and Wall Street Journal reported on Huang’s relations with Alice Huang, as well as US authorities’ suspicions that she was spying for China. Beijing has denied she is a spy.
Reuters has not independently verified whether Alice Huang was working on behalf of the Chinese government.

Jensen Huang said in an interview with Bloomberg published on Oct 29 that the US government had not informed him about its suspicions regarding Alice Huang.
Nvidia’s stock has fallen more than 30% since its October 6 closing high, erasing more than US1.8 trillion (S$2.32 trillion) from its market capitalisation. REUTERS

INDIAN WELLS, California, Nov 13 : Mirra Andreeva said she has learned to recover more quickly from setbacks after the Russian teenager completed an unbeaten run through the WTA Finals round-robin stage on Friday.
Andreeva won her third group-stage match in straight sets after a late opponent change, having already secured a semi-final berth. The 19-year-old said the match against tournament alternate Diana Shnaider presented a new mental challenge because her progression was guaranteed, but she still wanted to preserve her momentum.
"Before the tournament started I was afraid that I wouldn't win a match in the group," Andreeva told reporters. "Now you see how it turned out."
The victory set up a first career meeting with American Jessica Pegula on Saturday. Andreeva described Pegula as one of the calmest players on tour and said coach Conchita Martinez would help prepare a detailed tactical plan.

Andreeva's poise in the desert marked a contrast with her emotional exit from Indian Wells in March, when she lost her title defence to Katerina Siniakova. Frustrated by the defeat, Andreeva launched into a profanity-laced tirade toward spectators and was booed as she left the court.
The French Open champion said her response to losses has changed significantly over the course of the season.
"Before it was super bad. I was very dramatic," Andreeva said. "It would take me a good two, three days. I wouldn't talk to anybody. I would just sit in the room locked up, not wanting to practice."
Now, she said, disappointment generally lasts a day at most before the demands of the tour force her attention back to training or the next match.
Andreeva said the Indian Wells setback came while she was trying to incorporate changes made in practice into her match play, which produced inconsistency and frustration. She said continued work on court, along with sessions with psychologists, helped her make progress.
The results have followed. Andreeva won her first Grand Slam title at Roland Garros this year and arrived at the WTA Finals for her singles debut after a 50-win season.

items.title: US FAA grounds flights nationwide for second time since 9/11: What caused the disruption as 10,000 flights face delays?
items.author: Prabhakar Jha
items.summary: The FAA grounded US flights nationwide after a telecommunications outage disrupted air traffic control centres. More than 10,000 delays were reported, with cancellations and diversions mounting. This was the second nationwide ground stop since 9/11.
items.body: The US aviation system faced an unprecedented disruption after the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ordered a nationwide ground stop on Friday, halting departing flights at airports across the country, AP reported.While a full investigation is pending and no exact cause has come to fore, various reports mention the cause to be a communications outage that is affecting air traffic control centres.The disruption affected thousands of flights, leaving passengers stranded at airports, forcing airlines to divert aircraft and disrupting international travel.This was the second time since the September, 2001 (9/11) terrorist attack in the US state of New York that flight operations across the country has been halted. Another nationwide outage was reported in 2023.The FAA said the decision was taken as a precaution to ensure flight safety while technicians investigated the problem. Here is what happened, how many flights were affected and what authorities have said about the cause:What happened in the US?The FAA issued a nationwide ground stop on Friday afternoon (local time), instructing airports to halt all departing traffic until further notice.According to multiple reports, the problem stemmed from a telecommunications outage affecting the 22 air route traffic control centres that manage aircraft travelling between airports across the US.The ground stop did not mean that aircraft already flying were ordered to land immediately. Flights that were airborne continued towards their destinations, with authorities coordinating their safe landing.How many flights were affected by the FAA's ground stop?The disruption affected thousands of flights across the US, with cancellations, delays and diversions mounting as the stoppage continued.According to aviation analytics company Cirium and cited by AP, at least 600 flights had been diverted as of 5.50 pm Eastern Time on Friday.Of these, 496 flights were sent back to the airports from which they had originally departed, while 104 were diverted to alternative airports. Chicago O'Hare International Airport, Denver International Airport, Dallas Fort Worth International Airport and Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport were among the airports receiving diverted aircraft.The scale of the disruption was expected to increase. Around 11,000 flights carrying more than 1.5 million passengers had been scheduled to depart US airports after 4 pm Eastern Time on Friday.Flight-tracking website FlightAware reported more than 10,000 delays and over 4,000 cancellations within a short period of the disruption.FlightRadar24 estimated that around 3,100 aircraft were airborne and headed towards US airports when the ground stop began.What caused the nationwide flight disruption?The FAA initially attributed the ground stop to a temporary telecommunications outage affecting air traffic control operations. However, the exact cause of has not established as of yet.A CBS News report, citing multiple sources, said an update to the private communications network connecting the US air traffic control system had triggered a system reboot, resulting in a crash and communications outage.According to reports, investigators are examining whether a software update could have triggered the outage.Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there was no indication that the incident was a deliberate attack or a threat to the US.How were international flights affected?The European aviation agency Eurocontrol suspended all US-bound departures from its 42 member states at the FAA's request, Reuters reported. The suspension was scheduled to run from 5 pm Eastern Time on Friday until midnight.Mexico's federal aviation agency also grounded scheduled flights departing Mexican airports for the US.Air India warned that the nationwide ground stop could have consequential effects on its flights to and from the US. In a statement, the airline advised passengers to check their flight status before travelling to the airport.Is this the first time the US has grounded all flights nationwide?The latest incident was the first nationwide ground stop since January 2023, when a malfunction in a key FAA computer system disrupted flight operations across the country.Before that, the last nationwide grounding occurred following the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks.

PARIS, Nov 14 : World champions South Africa's hopes of lifting the first Nations Championship trophy ended with their 21-19 defeat in France on Friday, coach Rassie Erasmus said.
"I think we basically killed our dreams for the Nations Championship tonight with this performance and not getting the win and the four tries," Erasmus told a press conference.
South Africa, who suffered their first defeat of the Nations Championship, remain top of the Southern Hemisphere table on 21 points, but New Zealand are one point behind with a game in hand.
The Springboks will visit Ireland next week to conclude the group phase, while the All Blacks play Wales on Saturday before facing England the following Saturday.

Erasmus lamented his side's lack of discipline, as they conceded 11 penalties, eight of them in their own half. Lood de Jager was shown a yellow card for a high tackle, while Jasper Wiese was sent off for 20 minutes after the bunker upgraded his yellow card for a head-high hit.
"It hurt us. That caused us in a big way. I don't think any of that was intentional, but I agree that it should have been cards," Erasmus said.
"I guess the frustration is that the discipline cost us."
France also received three yellow cards through scrumhalf Maxime Lucu, winger Aaron Grandidier-Nkanang and tighthead prop Regis Montagne.
Erasmus was far from satisfied with the performance. It was also South Africa's first defeat against Les Bleus at the Stade de France since 2005.
"We didn't play well, so don’t find a lot of excuses," Erasmus said. "I don't think there's much more to blame than ourselves."

items.title: Nvidia crisis spurs scrutiny of US agency that oversees chip curbs
items.author: The Straits Times
items.summary: The Bureau of Industry and Security is a small yet powerful agency that sets export control policy and enforces US restrictions.
items.body:
Nvidia crisis spurs scrutiny of US agency that oversees chip curbs
Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox

Under Secretary of Commerce Jeffrey Kessler and the Bureau of Industry and Security are coming under fresh scrutiny for their handling of export restrictions.
PHOTO: REUTERS

Published   Nov 14, 2026, 08:55 AM

Updated   Nov 14, 2026, 08:55 AM

Set as preferred source

Summarise

US export control agency BIS is under fresh scrutiny after Nvidia’s Jensen Huang was considered for a conference speaker role, raising questions about its ties to chipmakers and China policy.
Congress is pressing Jeffrey Kessler and Howard Lutnick over Nvidia decisions, alleged poor transparency, staff shortages, and claims that BIS mishandled export controls on advanced AI chips.
The scandal has widened calls for tougher export laws, after Nvidia’s H200 sales to China and a BIS rule gap raised fears that Chinese firms could still get cutting-edge chips.

AI generated

WASHINGTON - The Trump administration official who runs US export control programmes was looking for marquee names for his agency’s upcoming annual conference and threw an unusual option into the mix: Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang.
Under Secretary of Commerce Jeffrey Kessler had expressed interest in recent months in inviting Huang to be a speaker at the Bureau of Industry and Security event on Jan 10 in Washington, according to people familiar with the matter who asked not to be identified discussing private deliberations. 
Kessler bragged about his ability to get Huang to attend, the people said, though the then-Nvidia chief ultimately fell out of the running. A BIS spokesperson said no speakers have been invited to the conference yet and planning is still underway.

Even considering Huang as a possible speaker was unusual because BIS regulates exports of Nvidia’s prized artificial intelligence chips and company executives rarely headline such events, the people said. There’s also the fact that Nvidia, one of the highest-profile subjects of BIS regulations, has vehemently opposed strict limits on selling advanced chips to Chinese customers.
In the wake of Huang’s abrupt downfall as CEO of the chipmaker he founded more than three decades ago, Kessler and his agency are coming under fresh scrutiny for their handling of export restrictions. Congress is demanding answers about whether BIS and the Commerce Department did enough to keep Nvidia’s AI processors out of China’s hands as well as the degree to which Silicon Valley leaders like Jensen Huang may have influenced policy.
“BIS sits at the intersection of America’s leading edge innovation and our need to protect against our adversaries stealing that innovation or using it against us,” said Christopher Padilla, who served as Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Export Administration during the Bush administration. “They are the tip of the spear for that.” 

Lawmakers are seizing on the revelations to press Kessler and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to explain their decisions related to Nvidia. House Republican Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast has asked that Kessler appear before his panel on Dec 3, while Lutnick has received a request to appear before the Senate Banking Committee on Dec 10. 
The scandal has fuelled a bipartisan push to pass export controls legislation before year’s end.
Huang’s departure was prompted by his admission that he’d had an affair with a woman suspected by US officials of spying for China and the company she led, Megaspeed, had been under investigation by Commerce for possible export control violations. Megaspeed has denied any wrongdoing, while the former Nvidia chief’s romantic partner, Alice Huang, is now in China.

At the centre of the mushrooming controversy is BIS, a small yet powerful agency that sets export control policy and enforces US restrictions. Kessler has led the bureau since early 2025, navigating between pressure from advocates of a tougher stance toward China and President Donald Trump’s desire to significantly boost global sales of American AI chips.
The people familiar with the matter described mismanagement and a lack of transparency around policy decisions under Kessler, with staff members siloed from their interagency counterparts and industry stakeholders.
On top of that is a questionable relationship between Lutnick and Kessler: one witness described instances where Lutnick screamed at Kessler in front of staff. The office has also faced a brain drain of experienced career staff over the past two years, which has led to bottlenecks and frustration, the people said. 
The BIS spokesperson challenged those characterisations, saying it’s normal to control the flow of information in a national security context and that Kessler and Lutnick have a strong working relationship. The account of a shouting match is baseless gossip, the spokesperson said. Spokespeople for the Commerce Department didn’t respond to a request for comment. 
Kessler’s desire to have Huang at the January event underscored the dissonance that has beset the office.
The conference is set to have a Golden Age theme, styled after a phrase frequently used by Trump, according to the people familiar with the matter. That’s in contrast to its normally staid agenda, which features BIS officials and policy geeks attending days of speeches and round tables on the latest regulations and enforcement actions.
Kessler’s consideration of Huang for a speaking role also followed Nvidia’s intervention in 2025 in a BIS probe of Megaspeed. In late summer 2025, Nvidia General Counsel Tim Teter called Kessler to ask whether BIS was involved in the Singapore government’s recent detention of Alice Huang, Bloomberg News reported this week. BIS was not involved in that action, Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
An Nvidia spokesperson has said that Teter was unaware of the affair at the time he called Kessler about Alice Huang’s detention in Singapore. But in the weeks following the call, BIS staff were muzzled in their ability to investigate the company, including a mandate that they route all request of Nvidia through Kessler, Bloomberg reported.
It remains unclear exactly where Kessler stands on Nvidia and Jensen Huang following the scandal, but previously, he was eager to foster a relationship with the then-CEO, taking cues from Lutnick and also from Trump, who had befriended Huang and praised his company, Bloomberg has reported.
Kessler’s agency carried out Trump’s decision in late 2025 to allow shipments of Nvidia’s H200 semiconductors to China, a move that prompted bipartisan backlash over concerns that giving Chinese firms access to advanced chips would boost their development of AI models. BIS is responsible for licensing H200 chip purchases by individual entities in China, and under the arrangement the US government receives a 25% cut of the revenue.
BIS also said in May 2025 that it wouldn’t enforce a regulation adopted in the Biden administration’s final days that was intended to restrict the ability of China and other US adversaries to acquire cutting-edge semiconductors by giving the closest US allies access to advanced GPUs while limiting access to other countries.
While BIS has promised a replacement, it has yet to introduce one, creating what some see as a loophole that may have allowed Chinese headquartered companies outside of China to purchase advanced chips. BLOOMBERG

items.title: Donald Trump se reunirá con Xi Jinping y Putin el 19 de noviembre en China
items.author: Courtney Subramanian, Jeff Mason
items.summary: La reunión entre los tres se produce, además, en un momento en que Trump busca una vía para poner fin a la guerra en Ucrania, que se prolonga desde hace más de cuatro años, desde la invasión de Rusia ...
items.body: Bloomberg — El presidente Donald Trump se reunirá con el presidente chino Xi Jinping y el presidente ruso Vladimir Putin el 19 de noviembre en el marco de la cumbre de Cooperación Económica Asia-Pacífico, según informó una portavoz de la Casa Blanca. Xi Jinping será el anfitrión de la cumbre de la APEC de este año, que tendrá lugar los días 18 y 19 de noviembre en Shenzhen, China. Ver más: EE.UU. suspende todos los vuelos por problemas de comunicación en el control del tráfico aéreo Trump ha dicho anteriormente que dicha reunión trilateral se centraría en la desnuclearización, una perspectiva poco probable dada la reticencia de China a discutir los límites a los arsenales nucleares con Rusia y Estados Unidos, países que poseen arsenales mucho mayores. La reunión entre los tres se produce, además, en un momento en que Trump busca una vía para poner fin a la guerra en Ucrania, que se prolonga desde hace más de cuatro años, desde la invasión de Rusia a principios de 2022. El viaje de Trump al extranjero se produce tras sufrir un revés político en su país a raíz de las elecciones de mitad de mandato del 3 de noviembre, en las que sus rivales demócratas obtuvieron el control de la Cámara de Representantes y el Senado de EE.UU. Se reunirá con los líderes del Quad —India, Japón y Australia, además de EE.UU.— en Manila, donde también firmará un acuerdo comercial con Tailandia y asistirá a la cumbre de la ASEAN organizada por Filipinas. A continuación, el presidente viajará a Shenzhen, donde tiene previsto reunirse tanto con Putin como con Xi, así como celebrar la tercera de las cuatro reuniones bilaterales previstas con el líder chino este año. Ver más: Corte Suprema de EE.UU. evaluará mantener la prohibición de Trump a solicitudes de asilo en la frontera sur La reunión entre Trump y Xi se produce en un momento en que los líderes de las dos mayores economías del mundo se enfrentan a una serie de retos, entre los que se incluyen el comercio y los aranceles, la carrera por el desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial, así como puntos conflictivos a escala mundial como Taiwán y la guerra de Estados Unidos contra Irán. Trump y Xi se reunieron por última vez en septiembre, cuando el presidente de EE.UU. agasajó al líder chino en la Casa Blanca con gran pompa, incluida una fastuosa cena de Estado. En septiembre, los dos líderes no anunciaron ningún avance significativo, pero lograron mantener estables las relaciones tras la agitación registrada a principios del segundo mandato de Trump, cuando una guerra comercial sacudió los mercados financieros. El anuncio más destacado de la reunión de otoño fue la decisión de prorrogar la tregua comercial hasta enero de 2027, aunque dicho acuerdo ya se había alcanzado incluso antes de que comenzara oficialmente la visita de Estado. Durante la cumbre celebrada en Washington, Trump se refirió en repetidas ocasiones a Xi —líder de un importante rival geopolítico— como un amigo, pasando por alto cuestiones más polémicas que dividen a sus países, como la guerra de Irán y Taiwán, la isla autónoma que Pekín reclama como propia. La guerra contra Irán, que Estados Unidos e Israel iniciaron a finales de febrero, y los posteriores esfuerzos por aislar económicamente a Teherán han puesto a prueba las relaciones entre Washington y Pekín. China fue el segundo socio comercial más importante de Irán en 2025 y uno de los principales compradores de petróleo de la República Islámica. Las refinerías chinas se han visto obligadas a recurrir a fuentes alternativas, ya que el flujo de crudo iraní se ha visto cortado por un bloqueo naval estadounidense. Ver más: Los 10 países con mayor productividad laboral por hora en América Latina y el Caribe Trump también ha reflexionado en repetidas ocasiones sobre la posibilidad de que China venda armas a Irán, afirmando que se sentiría decepcionado si Pekín lo hiciera y añadiendo que Xi le había asegurado que no lo harían. Se espera que ambos líderes se reúnan de nuevo en la cumbre del Grupo de los 20 que se celebrará en Doral, Florida, en diciembre. --Con la colaboración de Kevin Whitelaw. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: サッカー＝ベッカム氏米国サッカー殿堂入り、ラピノー氏とアーツ氏も
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１３日　ロイター］ - 米国サッカー殿堂は１２日、元イングランド代表主将のデービッド・ベッカム氏（５１）、元米国女子代表のミーガン・ラピノー氏（４１）、ジュリー・アーツ氏（３４）らが２０２７年の殿堂入りメンバーに選出されたと発表した。

ベッカム氏は０７年に米メジャーリーグサッカー（ＭＬＳ）のロサンゼルス・ギャラクシーに加入し、１１年と１２年のリーグ制覇に貢献。現在は元アルゼンチン代表リオネル・メッシが所属するインテル・マイアミの共同オーナーを務める。

ラピノー氏とアーツ氏はともに、米国が１５年と１９年の女子ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）を制した際の主力選手で、資格取得１年目での選出となった。

ラピノー氏は０６年から２３年まで米国代表として２０３試合に出場し、６３得点を記録。１９年の女子Ｗ杯では得点王と最優秀選手に輝き、同年の女子バロンドール（フランス・フットボール誌選定の権威ある年間最優秀選手賞）も受賞した。アーツ氏は代表１２３試合で２０得点を挙げた。

このほか、元米国代表ＦＷジョジー・アルティドール氏（３７）、元同代表監督ローター・オジアンダー氏（８７）、室内サッカーで８００得点以上を挙げたタトゥ氏（６４）も選ばれた。殿堂入り式典は来年４月１６日にテキサス州フリスコで開催される。

items.title: Volaris, Aeroméxico y Viva advierten demoras y cancelaciones en vuelos por falla en EE.UU.
items.author: Italia López
items.summary: Autoridades de EE.UU. pidieron que los aviones en aeropuertos mexicanos con vuelos programados a ese país se mantuvieran en tierra.
items.body: Ciudad de México — Las aerolíneas mexicanas Volaris, Aeroméxico y Viva advirtieron posibles demoras o cancelaciones en los vuelos desde o hacia Estados Unidos por órdenes de las autoridades de aviación de ese país tras una falla en el control de tráfico aéreo. El viernes, la Administración Federal de Aviación (FAA, por su sigla en inglés) de EE.UU. determinó suspender hasta nuevo aviso los despegues de aviones en todos los aeropuertos en su territorio y dijo que los vuelos internacionales se gestionarían caso por caso. “Como parte de estas medidas, se solicitó que todas las aeronaves en los aeropuertos mexicanos con vuelos programados hacia Estados Unidos permanezcan en tierra hasta que las autoridades aeronáuticas de ese país autoricen la reanudación de los vuelos”, dijo la Agencia Federal de Aviación Civil (AFAC) de México. Ver más: EE.UU. suspende todos los vuelos por problemas de comunicación en el control del tráfico aéreo La AFAC recomendó a los viajeros con destino a Estados Unidos consultar el estado de sus vuelos a través de los canales oficiales de sus aerolíneas y de los grupos aeroportuarios correspondientes. Aeroméxico dijo en sus redes sociales que la suspensión determinada por las autoridades estadounidenses estaba generando afectaciones en diversos vuelos y liberó una política de protección para clientes afectados. En tanto, Viva Aerobus y Volaris informaron que algunos vuelos podrían presentar demoras, ajustes de itinerario o cancelaciones. En mensajes separados, las aerolíneas recomendaron a los pasajeros consultar el estatus de sus vuelos a través de sus sitios web o aplicaciones móviles. Las autoridades estadounidenses indicaron que todos los centros de control de tráfico aéreo en el país fueron afectados por un problema de comunicación. De acuerdo con Bloomberg, la FAA ha enfrentado interrupciones en sus instalaciones de tráfico aéreo en los últimos años por a equipos obsoletos, por lo que inició una plan de renovación desde 2025 para el que solicitó recursos adicionales.

items.title: Disney cambia su postura frente a la IA: la incorpora a la animación, las finanzas y el cine
items.author: Dawn C. Chmielewski, Thomas Buckley
items.summary: La apuesta de D’Amaro por la inteligencia artificial marca un nuevo enfoque para Disney. Bajo el liderazgo de su anterior CEO, Bob Iger, Disney combinaba incentivos y medidas de presión.
items.body: Bloomberg — Un siglo después de que Walt Disney Co. ( DIS ) cautivara a los cinéfilos con un ratón dibujado a mano que aparecía en la pantalla grande con sonido sincronizado, la compañía de entretenimiento más grande del mundo explora ahora una nueva frontera en la animación: la inteligencia artificial. En diciembre, la compañía estrenará Ozzy Fox , una serie infantil animada con IA, en su plataforma insignia de streaming Disney+. Ozzy Fox , sobre un personaje naranja que canta con frecuencia, es el resultado de un año de colaboración con la startup francesa Animaj, cuyas herramientas de IA convierten los dibujos a mano y las instrucciones de texto de los artistas en animación tridimensional. Este es solo un ejemplo de una misión más amplia, liderada por el CEO Josh D’Amaro, para llevar a la compañía de 103 años de antigüedad, hogar de las princesas Disney, Pixar y Star Wars, a la era de la IA. Ver más: Disney presenta Infinity Vision a Paramount, Universal y otros estudios de Hollywood Apenas una semana después de que D’Amaro asumiera el cargo de CEO, OpenAI cerró su plataforma de conversión de texto a video Sora, frustrando una alianza planificada de tres años que habría supuesto una inversión de mil millones de dólares por parte de Disney en la startup y la concesión de licencias para más de 200 de sus personajes en videos cortos generados por IA. Desde entonces, la compañía ha seguido su propio camino y se apoya en la inteligencia artificial para modernizar todas sus unidades, desde finanzas hasta cine. Al mismo tiempo, Disney ha buscado reducir costos, medidas que han derivado en despidos frecuentes, mientras los canales de televisión tradicionales de la compañía luchan por retener a la audiencia y a los anunciantes. La apuesta de D’Amaro por la inteligencia artificial marca un nuevo enfoque para Disney. Bajo el liderazgo de su anterior CEO, Bob Iger, Disney combinaba incentivos y medidas de presión. La compañía emprendió acciones legales contra startups como Midjourney Inc. y MiniMax por presuntas infracciones de derechos de autor, después de que circularan en redes sociales imágenes de Mickey Mouse empuñando una ametralladora y representaciones grotescas de las princesas de Disney. Al mismo tiempo, colaboraba con OpenAI, que se comprometió a actuar de manera responsable. El fracaso inicial del acuerdo entre Disney y OpenAI, y la amenaza de que la IA reemplace a los artistas, evidencian la lucha de Hollywood por conciliar la promesa de una producción cinematográfica más barata y rápida con el temor a que pueda socavar el talento creativo y la propiedad intelectual de los que depende la industria. Estas preocupaciones impulsaron las huelgas paralizantes de actores y guionistas en 2023 y siguen latentes durante la recesión económica que azota Los Ángeles. Ver más: Disney quiere a Bluey: su presidenta dice que “ofrecería mucho dinero” por derechos de propiedad intelectual Pocas compañías se juegan tanto como Disney. Tras adquisiciones por valor de más de US$100.000 millones en las últimas dos décadas, desde Marvel hasta Pixar, Lucasfilm (propietaria de Star Wars) y 21st Century Fox (propietaria de Los Simpson) , Disney posee uno de los catálogos más ricos de personajes, historias y franquicias de la industria. Disney no ha definido una estrategia global de IA, pero equipos de toda la compañía están experimentando con diferentes aplicaciones, lo que sugiere el potencial de un uso generalizado de la tecnología. En septiembre, la compañía nombró a Karandeep Anand —un veterano de la tecnología que recientemente dirigió una startup de IA— como su primer director de tecnología, una clara señal del papel que probablemente desempeñará la IA en el futuro del gigante del entretenimiento. Al igual que otros estudios de Hollywood, Disney comenzó introduciendo la IA en áreas del negocio donde es menos probable que encuentre resistencia creativa. La compañía está desarrollando Disney Financial Insights (D-Fi), una plataforma de colaboración con IA que puede reemplazar y automatizar los informes presupuestarios manuales, centralizando la visibilidad, las aprobaciones y los análisis, según fuentes cercanas a los planes. También está probando sugerencias basadas en IA con algunos suscriptores estadounidenses del servicio de streaming insignia Disney+. Los usuarios pueden hablar o elegir entre sugerencias para describir lo que quieren ver, y el algoritmo les recomendará títulos relevantes. Documentos presentados ante la Oficina de Patentes y Marcas de EE.UU. insinúan ambiciones mayores. En la división de parques de Disney, una solicitud presentada a principios de este año describe un escenario en el que un personaje con IA en los resorts de la compañía pregunta a los visitantes sobre sus recuerdos favoritos para compararlos con los recuerdos programados del propio personaje, en un intercambio que imita una conversación significativa entre humanos. Disney también patentó un mecanismo mediante el cual los micrófonos con inteligencia artificial detectan pequeños cambios en el sonido de las atracciones para avisar a los operadores del mantenimiento necesario y evitar posibles problemas. Las patentes dan una idea de la visión de la empresa, pero no garantizan que las ideas se hagan realidad. Ver más: Messi presenta su serie animada para Disney+: la produjo junto a su padre y llegará en 2027 En un evento para los medios de comunicación celebrado a principios de este mes en la sede de Disney en Burbank, California, la compañía mostró cómo la tecnología de IA de cinco startups que participaron en su programa anual Accelerator podría mejorar las operaciones. Se presentaron robots autónomos construidos al estilo de los personajes de la película Cars de Pixar para guiar a los huéspedes del resort a los estacionamientos, y herramientas para revolucionar la producción cinematográfica tradicional con un proceso de producción híbrido que sitúa la actuación de un actor en un entorno generado por IA. “Estamos explorando activamente las tecnologías emergentes y viendo cómo pueden apoyar a nuestros creadores y ayudarnos a ofrecer experiencias aún más atractivas y personalizadas en todo el mundo”, dijo D’Amaro en el evento. En octubre, Dana Walden, presidenta y directora creativa de Disney, y Alan Bergman, presidente de los estudios de entretenimiento, visitaron los estudios MGM de Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ) en Los Ángeles para ver una demostración de cómo el gigante tecnológico está utilizando la IA para acelerar la producción de películas de acción real y animación, según fuentes cercanas al asunto. Según una de las personas consultadas, que pidió permanecer en el anonimato al tratarse de información que no es pública, las dos empresas se reúnen habitualmente. Ese mismo mes, Disney también anunció la adquisición de algunos activos de Character.AI y la contratación de 60 empleados. La startup de chatbots se declaró en bancarrota tras una avalancha de demandas por negligencia y homicidio culposo. El acuerdo de US$20 millones le brindaría a Disney experiencia en IA conversacional y le permitiría desarrollar sistemas internos con procedimientos de seguridad más rigurosos, que podrían crear nuevas formas de interacción entre los consumidores y sus personajes. Según fuentes cercanas, Disney podría incorporar conversaciones con personajes como una función en Disney+, aunque no hay nada inminente al respecto. Anand, el nuevo director de tecnología de Disney, fue anteriormente CEO de Character.AI. En Disney, supervisará y centralizará las iniciativas de inteligencia artificial de la compañía. Jamie Voris, quien anteriormente supervisó la adopción de la IA en Disney en la Oficina de Habilitación Tecnológica, y Eddie Drake, quien reemplazó a Voris en su anterior cargo de director de tecnología en Walt Disney Studios en 2024, se jubilarán, según fuentes cercanas al asunto. Ni Voris ni Drake respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios de Bloomberg . Ver más: Disney+ sube de precio: cuánto costará desde ahora y qué pasa con Hulu Otra forma en que Disney está ampliando el uso de la IA sin perder el control de su propiedad intelectual es a través de su asociación con Adobe Inc. Esta relación se consolidó a principios de este mes con un nuevo acuerdo plurianual que le dará a Disney acceso anticipado a las herramientas de Adobe, incluyendo IA generativa y software de edición de video y fotografía, para respaldar los proyectos creativos en toda la compañía, desde ESPN hasta los cruceros de Disney. Según un alto ejecutivo familiarizado con su estrategia, Disney está más centrada en controlar el uso de sus personajes y preservar su exclusividad que en recibir pagos de empresas de IA por entrenar sus modelos con el contenido del estudio. Al igual que la adquisición de Pixar Animation Studios por parte de Disney en 2006, que revolucionó el uso de gráficos por computadora innovadores y marcó el comienzo de una nueva era en la animación, D’Amaro considera que la inversión en IA es una evolución lógica del modelo de Hollywood. “La tecnología en sí misma no es el objetivo”, afirmó D’Amaro en el evento Accelerator. “Se trata de volver a poner la tecnología en manos de nuestros creadores para que puedan crear historias increíbles e inmersivas”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: サッカー＝ロナウジーニョ、約11年ぶりに公式戦復帰へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１３日　ロイター］ - サッカーの元ブラジル代表ロナウジーニョ（４６）が約１１年ぶりとなる公式戦に出場する。同選手が加入したイタリア・セリエＣのラベンナの監督が明かした。

現役時代の２００３年から０８年まで所属したバルセロナ（スペイン）で世界的な名声を手にしたロナウジーニョは、１５年にフルミネンセ（ブラジル）を退団後、１８年に引退を表明。今年６月にはラベンナと契約し、クラブの出資者にも名を連ねた。

１５年以来公式戦から遠ざかっているロナウジーニョが選手としてピッチに立つのか疑問視する声もあった。しかし、ラベンナは３週間前、ロナウジーニョが１５日に行われるフォルリとのホーム戦で復帰すると発表した。

ラベンナのアンドレア・マンドルリーニ監督は１３日、記者団に対し、「間違いなく、彼は先発で出場する」と明言。続けて、「どのくらいの時間プレーするかは彼と相談するつもりだ。彼は現代サッカー界における偉大な選手の一人で、われわれには結果が必要。われわれは常に３トップの布陣で戦っており、彼もその３人のうちの一人としてプレーする」と述べた。

ホームスタジアムには、観客収容のための仮設スタンドも設置。ロナウジーニョはゴールを決めれば、プロキャリア通算３００得点目となる。

INDIAN WELLS, California, Nov 13 : Elina Svitolina overwhelmed Aryna Sabalenka in the deciding set to seal a 6-3 3-6 6-1 upset on Friday to reach the semi-finals of the season-ending WTA Finals in Indian Wells, where she will face Linda Noskova.
Svitolina absorbed and redirected Sabalenka's power effectively, breaking the Belarusian six times before sealing her first victory over her opponent in more than six years with a forehand winner on her fourth match point. With the win, Svitolina improved to 2-6 against Sabalenka in their career meetings. 
"It was a bit of a roller-coaster match," Svitolina told reporters.
"I played well in the first set but lost a little bit of rhythm. She played well in the second and served much better. I was really happy with the way I could come back in the third after losing the first game."

NO HANDSHAKE
The Ukrainian again did not shake hands with Sabalenka after the match, maintaining her policy of not doing so with Russian and Belarusian players following Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
Svitolina, the 2018 WTA Finals champion, will face Noskova on Saturday for a place in the final.
The defeat ended Sabalenka's season on a disappointing note. The second seed won Brisbane International in January and then Indian Wells and the Miami Open in March to complete the "Sunshine Double" but did not claim another title after that.
Sabalenka also surrendered the world number one ranking to Elena Rybakina at the US Open. She had entered the season finale among the favourites after Rybakina withdrew on the eve of the tournament because of illness.
Sabalenka declined to speak to the media following Friday's loss.
ANDREEVA ROLLS
Earlier in the day, tournament debutant Andreeva continued her impressive run with a 6-2 6-1 win over fellow Russian Diana Shnaider, her third straight-sets victory of the week.
Shnaider, Andreeva's friend and doubles partner, replaced Karolina Muchova, who withdrew before the final day of round-robin matches with a gastrointestinal illness.
Andreeva had already secured her place in the semi-finals before facing Shnaider and will meet American Jessica Pegula on Saturday.
The eight-day, $10 million tournament was moved from Riyadh to Indian Wells Tennis Garden due to the US-Israeli war on Iran. The event will be played in Charlotte starting next year.

Nov 13 : The International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) has filed a challenge with the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) over its ruling to reinstate Russian teams in next year's world championships, according to media reports on Friday. 
The Athletic and TSN reported that the governing body's challenge is based on the non-disclosure of ties to Russia by two of the three CAS panel members involved in the decision.
The IIHF and CAS did not immediately respond to requests for comment from Reuters.  
The Lausanne-based court last month ordered the IIHF to admit Russian teams to five upcoming tournaments, beginning with the World Junior Championship in Alberta that runs from December 26 to January 5.

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 13 : An internet trade group sued New York on Friday, seeking to block a state law requiring social media platforms that contain potentially addictive features to provide state-approved warning labels for users.
In a complaint filed in federal court, NetChoice said the law violates the free speech protections of the US Constitution's First Amendment by compelling its members to convey the state's "preferred message" about online safety.
The office of New York Attorney General Letitia James, who enforces the state's laws, declined immediate comment.
NetChoice has more than 30 members including Alphabet's Google and YouTube, Facebook and Instagram parent Meta Platforms, Snapchat parent Snap and ByteDance's TikTok. It has filed many lawsuits challenging regulation of social media businesses.

Signed by Governor Kathy Hochul last December, the New York law requires social media platforms with infinite scrolling, auto-play and algorithmic feeds to warn about potential harm to younger users.
It requires the display of a "warning" from the US Surgeon General that while social media may benefit some young users, "excessive use may be associated with significant mental health harms."
The statement is modeled after findings in 2023 by former US Surgeon General Vivek Murthy.
NetChoice said New York's law is "designed to block, burden, and browbeat social media users" by subjecting them to the warning when they sign on and after multiple hours of use, with no way to bypass it.
"Unlike a static warning on a product label, these warnings repeatedly interrupt users and block access to protected speech," NetChoice said.
NetChoice filed a similar lawsuit against California last month.
It also said New York's law is similar to a Colorado law that a federal judge blocked in November 2025, citing the First Amendment. Colorado is appealing that decision.
New York's law is scheduled to take effect on January 1.

Source: Reuters

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［アムステルダム　１３日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［アムステルダム　１３日　ロイター］　 - サッカーの欧州ネーションズリーグ（ＮＬ）は１３日、各地で１次リーグの試合を行い、リーグＡの２組ではオランダがホームでギリシャに７─０で大勝した。

開始６分にクリセンシオ・サマーフィルのゴールで先制したオランダは、タイアニ・ラインデルスが前半だけでハットトリックを達成。その後、ユリエン・ティンバーの２得点に、ドニエル・マレンもネットを揺らした。

同組のドイツは、敵地でセルビアに３─１で勝利した。前半３分に相手オウンゴールで先手を取ったドイツは、同１４分にフロリアン・ビルツが加点。後半５分には、代表デビュー戦となったブラヤン・グルダが３得点目をマークすると、その後に１点を返されたが、終盤に２選手が退場した相手を振り切った。

勝ち点１１としたオランダが首位に立ち、ドイツは勝ち点８でギリシャと並んだ。３チームは１６日の１次リーグ最終戦で準々決勝進出への２枠を争う。

items.title: 野球＝日本が韓国破り2連勝、宗山が決勝3ラン　アジアプロ野球
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１３日　ロイター］ - 野球のアジアプロ野球チャンピオンシップは１３日、東京ドームで１次リーグの試合を行い、日本は韓国を９─５で下して２連勝とし、決勝進出に大きく前進した。

日本は１点を追う三回、正木智也内野手が２試合連続本塁打となる２ランを放ち逆転。六回には小島大河捕手のソロ本塁打で加点し、七回には宗山塁内野手の２ランで５─１とリードを広げた。

八回表には適時打と３ランを浴びて４点差を追いつかれたものの、その裏の２死一、二塁から宗山が２打席連続本塁打となる勝ち越し３ランを右翼席に運び、山口航輝内野手の適時二塁打でさらに１点を加えた。

宗山は５打数３安打５打点と活躍。日本の先発、竹丸和幸投手は４回を５安打１失点、６三振と力投し、５番手の森田駿哉投手が勝利投手となった。

もう１試合では台湾がオーストラリアを６─４で破り、ともに１勝１敗となった。日本は１４日にオーストラリアと対戦する。

大会は２４歳以下かプロ入り３年目までの選手を中心に、２９歳以下のオーバーエイジ枠も３人まで認められる。日本、韓国、台湾、オーストラリアの４チームが１回戦総当たりの１次リーグを戦い、１５日に上位２チームによる決勝と下位２チームによる３位決定戦を行う。

DAN
MAUMEE, Ohio, Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Dana Incorporated ( DAN ) ("Dana" or the "Company") announced today the pricing, expiration and results of its tender offers to purchase for cash any and all of its outstanding 4.250% Senior Notes due 2030 (the "2030 Notes") and 4.500% Senior Notes due 2032 (the "2032 Notes" and, together with the 2030 Notes, the "Notes"). Nov 13 : Soros Fund Management, the family office of billionaire George Soros, significantly raised its stake in Intel in the third quarter, a regulatory filing showed on Friday.
Here are more details:
• The investment firm built a 2.83 million-share position valued at $340.3 million as it boosted its exposure to the major PC chip supplier
• The fund had held just 100,000 Intel shares at the end of June, according to its previous quarterly disclosure, marking one of the most striking changes in its portfolio

• The fund cut its stake in Apple by 25.7 per cent to 393,680 shares and in ON Semiconductor by 92.7 per cent to 16,594 shares

items.title: ゴルフ＝西郷と勝が2打差の4位、岩井明は急浮上　米女子ツアー
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１３日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフのアニカ・ゲインブリッジ・ペリカンは１３日、フロリダ州ベレアのペリカンＧＣ（パー７０）で第２ラウンドを行い、西郷真央と勝みなみが通算１０アンダーの１３０で、首位と２打差の４位につけた。

前日９位の西郷は６バーディー、１ボギーの６５をマークし、順位を５つ上げた。首位で発進した勝は３バーディー、２ボギーの６９で順位を下げた。

２０位で出た吉田優利は５バーディー、１ボギーの６６で回り、通算８アンダーの９位に浮上。前日９７位と出遅れた岩井明愛は９バーディー、ノーボギーの６１をたたき出し、通算７アンダーの１１位まで順位を大きく上げた。

前日２０位の西村優菜も６７で回り、岩井明と並ぶ１１位。岩井千怜は１８位、原英莉花は２５位につけた。古江彩佳は４３位、渋野日向子は５０位。笹生優花、馬場咲希、竹田麗央はいずれも５９位だった。

items.title: サッカー＝マンＵ新監督にポチェッティーノ氏、降格圏脱出へ再建託す
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［マンチェスター　１３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［マンチェスター　１３日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグ、マンチェスター・ユナイテッド（マンＵ）は１３日、米国代表を率いるマウリシオ・ポチェッティーノ氏（５４）を新監督に迎えることを決めた。

リーグ優勝２０回を誇るマンＵは、２０１３年を最後に国内リーグの頂点から遠ざかっている。今季はリーグ戦１０試合でわずか１勝の１８位と降格圏に沈み、同時期の順位としては１９８６─８７年シーズン以来の低さ。公式戦１５試合でも３勝にとどまり、最下位クリスタルパレスとの勝ち点差はわずか１となっている。

マンＵはアレックス・ファーガソン元監督の下でプレミアリーグ１３回、欧州チャンピオンズリーグ（ＣＬ）２回の優勝を達成したが、同氏が退任して以降は監督交代を繰り返し、かつての強さを取り戻せていない。

ポチェッティーノ氏は１８日に就任予定。英メディアによると、契約期間は２９年まで、初陣は２２日に敵地で行われるリバプールとの一戦となる。マンＵが同氏を招へいするために米国サッカー連盟へ支払う補償金は１０００万ドル（約１６億円）に上る見通し。米国代表監督としての契約は３０年ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）まで残っていた。

同氏は若手の育成やチームの組織力強化に定評がある。スペインのエスパニョールで監督としてのキャリアを始め、サウサンプトンで評価を高めると、トットナム（ともにイングランド）ではＣＬの常連へと成長させ、１９年には決勝進出に導いた。

一方、パリ・サンジェルマン（ＰＳＧ）ではフランス１部リーグ優勝を果たしたものの、悲願の欧州制覇には届かず、チェルシー（イングランド）でも主要タイトルを獲得できなかった。

CAPE TOWN, Nov 13 : Tunisia’s dismal run continued with a 2-0 home defeat by Libya in an Africa Cup of Nations qualifier on Friday, while Mohamed Salah became Egypt’s record scorer in their 5-0 rout of Malawi.
There were key wins for Cape Verde and Nigeria, who had made disappointing starts to the 2027 qualifying campaign, but there were also frustrating home draws for past winners South Africa and Zambia.
Salah scored twice late on to take his international tally to 70 and surpass former captain Hossam Hassan’s record. New coach Ali Maher began his tenure with a comprehensive victory in Cairo that put Egypt top of Group B.
Tunisia were the only one of Africa’s 10 teams at this year's World Cup to exit following the group stage, and they fired coach Sabri Lamouchi after their opening defeat.

Their woes continued against neighbours Libya on Friday as they lost 2-0 in Sfax to a penalty from Ali Youssef on the stroke of halftime and a 62nd minute effort from Hamdou El Houni.  
The defeat left Tunisia with two points at the halfway stage of their Group H campaign and in danger of missing next year’s finals, which would end their record run of 17 successive appearances. Coach Mouin Chaabani’s short reign is also under threat.
Cape Verde, who thrilled the neutrals with their run to the second round at the World Cup, had lost their opening qualifiers in September but were back to winning ways on Friday with a 4-2 home triumph over Liberia, with debutant Derensili Sanches Fernandes from Huddersfield Town among the scorers.
Nigeria made multiple changes to their line-up after a 3-0 loss to Guinea Bissau in their last outing two months ago and bounced back with giant striker Tolu Arokodare scoring twice in their 3-1 win over Tanzania.
CAME FROM BEHIND
Defender Jean Girumugisha scored seven minutes from time for tiny Burundi to draw 1-1 away at Zambia in Group I while Ryan Ogam’s 90th minute strike saw Kenya hold South Africa 2-2 in Johannesburg in Group D.
Mali came from behind to beat Rwanda 3-2 in Bamako and win a third match in Group K and move within one win of a place in the finals. Mamadou Camara snatched their late winner.
African Footballer of the Year Achraf Hakimi scored twice as Morocco beat Niger 5-1 in Casablanca to maintain their perfect start in Group A and move closer to qualification.
There are three more matches on Saturday to complete the third round of the group qualifiers which marks the halfway mark of the campaign. 
The fourth round of group fixtures is on Monday and Tuesday and the last two rounds in March. The 2027 finals are to be co-hosted by Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda from June 19-July 17.

items.title: Court allows news publishers' copyright lawsuit against OpenAI to go ahead
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: The Ontario Court of Appeal is allowing a copyright lawsuit filed by Canadian news publishers against OpenAI to proceed in that province after dismissing an appeal by the company.
items.body: OTTAWA — The Ontario Court of Appeal is allowing a copyright lawsuit filed by Canadian news publishers against OpenAI to proceed in that province after dismissing an appeal by the company. A coalition of Canadian news outlets which includes The Canadian Press, Torstar, The Globe and Mail, Postmedia and CBC/Radio-Canada launched the lawsuit two years ago. They argue OpenAI is using their news content to train ChatGPT, breaching copyright and profiting from the use of that content without permission or compensation. OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT, put forward a jurisdictional challenge and argued the case should be heard in a U.S. courtroom instead. The Ontario Superior Court of Justice concluded the court does have jurisdiction to hear the case. OpenAI appealed the decision and the court dismissed that appeal Friday. The decision said OpenAI did not file any evidence showing a judgment in Canada would conflict with any existing United States laws, which would complicate enforcement. It also said the judge found “the fair and efficient working of the Canadian legal system favoured allowing Canadian authors to bring claims against foreign companies for breaches of Canadian laws.” The lawsuit, which has dragged on since 2024, is the first Canadian case to address the practice of using copyrighted content to train generative AI systems. Earlier this year, Postmedia, Torstar, The Globe and Mail and The Canadian Press launched a separate lawsuit against AI company Anthropic. News and cultural industry groups have called on the federal government to take a stand on how AI systems use copyrighted content, but Ottawa has not indicated any plans to do so or to update the Copyright Act.  Multiple lawsuits dealing with AI systems and copyright are underway in the United States, some dating back to 2023. That includes a case by a group of publishers including the Toronto Star, Condé Nast and McClatchy alleging Canadian AI company Cohere infringed their copyright by scraping their articles from the internet without the publishers’ permission or compensation. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 13, 2026. The Canadian Press

France hold off South Africa after tactical gamble pays off

FAST

PARIS, Nov 13 : France beat South Africa 21-19 in a tactically intriguing contest on Friday, with Fabien Galthie's side overcoming the world champions after outfoxing Rassie Erasmus in a battle of coaching gambles.
South Africa's wholesale front-row changes had little impact on France's own ploy, with Antoine Dupont named at flyhalf before moving to his customary scrumhalf role during the match.
Dupont played a key role as the Six Nations champions secured their first victory over South Africa at the Stade de France since 2005. Aaron Grandidier-Nkanang, Theo Attissogbe and Louis Bielle-Biarrey scored France's tries, while Maxime Lucu kicked six points.
Jan-Hendrik Wessels, Cobus Reinach and Malcolm Marx crossed for South Africa, with Sacha Feinberg-Mngomezulu converting the first two tries. Jasper Wiese was shown a 20-minute red card after his yellow card was upgraded by the bunker review system for a dangerous clear-out at a ruck.

The victory left France on top of the Northern Hemisphere standings on 21 points. South Africa, suffering their first defeat of the Nations Championship, remained top of the Southern Hemisphere table on 21 points but could come under pressure from New Zealand.
France’s win underlined their credentials as contenders for the 2027 World Cup, exactly a year before the final, after they had lost nine of their previous 10 meetings with the Springboks.
That run included a one-point quarter-final defeat on home soil at the 2023 World Cup and a 32-17 loss last year, when South Africa had a player sent off before halftime.
France’s preparations were again disrupted by injuries, with hooker Julien Marchand hurt in the warm-up and replaced by Peato Mauvaka.
Flyhalf Romain Ntamack had dislocated his shoulder in last week’s win over Fiji and, with Matthieu Jalibert, Thomas Ramos and Antoine Hastoy also sidelined, Galthie handed Dupont his first international start at flyhalf and selected Lucu at scrumhalf.
The shirt numbers proved deceptive, however, as Dupont operated predominantly in his customary scrumhalf role and Lucu filled in at flyhalf, as he had after replacing Ntamack against Fiji.
UNCERTAINTY OVER ROLES
"It's an idea I put to them when we knew Ntamack wouldn’t be playing," Galthie told a press conference.
"They had a discussion, we watched a few matches, and we had a 40-minute training session and a 10-minute team run to set it up. I think it worked really well. Both of them played an outstanding game."
South Africa had expected the pair to swap roles during the match, but Erasmus said the uncertainty made France harder to prepare for.
"They have, at one position, a lot of injuries, but having Lucu and Dupont maybe strengthened the team in a way," Erasmus told reporters.
"(Dupont) is a brilliant player and it's difficult to plan against, especially when we didn't know he was going to play 10 or 9."
The pair were influential throughout as France made the most of Lood de Jager’s 13th-minute yellow card for a high tackle on Lucu, scoring twice during his absence.
Dupont passed to Lucu in the move that ended with Aaron Grandidier-Nkanang scoring the opening try before the France captain’s left-footed 50-22 kick created the platform for Attissogbe’s effort.
Dupont then sent Bielle-Biarrey over with a grubber kick in the 32nd minute.
South Africa were forced to chase the game but Jan-Hendrik Wessels, drafted into the starting side when Erasmus reshuffled his front row about an hour before kick-off, scored from a lineout maul on the half-hour.
Errors and indiscipline disrupted the second half, with Wiese handed a 20-minute red card before Grandidier-Nkanang was sent to the sin bin six minutes later for a deliberate knock-on.
The winger’s yellow card came just as Lucu returned after being sin-binned for a high tackle shortly before halftime.
Reinach powered over a minute later and South Africa dominated much of the second half before Marx scored from another maul after France tighthead prop Regis Montagne was shown a yellow card.
Libbok had the chance to level the scores but sent the conversion wide with seven minutes remaining.
France then survived a final South African attack before the home crowd erupted at the final whistle.
The match marked the first time a sporting event had been staged at the Stade de France on November 13 since the 2015 Paris attacks, which began outside the stadium.
France face Argentina next week, while South Africa travel to Ireland, before the teams could meet again in the final.

Source: Reuters

DUBLIN, Nov 13 (Reuters) – Irish army bomb experts made a crude but viable explosive device safe at an office building in central Dublin on Friday, close to where world leaders dined a day earlier during a two-day summit in the Irish capital.

Irish police said they responded to a report of a suspicious device on Friday afternoon in the building on Merrion Square. Leaders from the European Political Community that includes EU and non-EU countries had met for dinner at a venue on another side of the square on Thursday.

“Based on initial Garda (police) assessment the defence forces Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) team were requested to attend the scene. The EOD team has made what is a crude but viable device safe,” police said in a statement.

Show Full Article

An investigation is under way, the statement added. It did not say when police believe the bomb was planted or give other details about it.

French President Emmanuel Macron, British Prime Minister Andy Burnham and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney — a guest at the event — attended the dinner at the National Gallery of Ireland.

A security cordon was placed around the venue for the dinner, with roads within the vicinity of Merrion Square closed off. Police said the two-day gathering was the largest security operation they had ever undertaken.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy was also at the summit but did not attend the dinner as he was meeting US presidential envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff on the outskirts of Dublin.

The summit, which continued on Friday with an informal meeting of EU leaders, was held at a separate venue 1.5 kilometres away from where the device was discovered. 

(Reporting by Padraic Halpin, Editing by Rosalba O’Brien)

items.title: バンス氏、28年大統領選出馬見送り検討か　中間選挙共和敗北で＝報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１３日 ロイター] - ２０２８年米大統領選の共和党有力候補と目されてきたバンス副大統領が、出馬を見送る可能性を検討しているもようだ。ＣＮＮが１３日、同氏に近い複数の関係者の話として報じた。背景には、先週の中間選挙で共和党が大敗したことがある。

バンス氏は中間選挙後、イラン戦争が共和党敗北の理由だったとの認識を示し、トランプ大統領が進めた対イラン政策との距離を置く姿勢を示した。バンス氏の側近はＣＮＮに対し、「イランとの戦争を終結できなければ、２０２８年に共和党が勝利する見込みはない」と語った。

さらにＣＮＮによると、バンス氏は、ほころびが生じている「ＭＡＧＡ（米国を再び偉大に）」支持層を再び結集させる取り組みを自身が主導すべきかどうかについても疑問を抱いているという。

また、今年第４子が誕生したこともあり、大統領選への出馬について慎重な姿勢を強めているともみられる。

Nov 13 : Equatorial Guinea goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been handed a 12-match suspension by the Spanish Football Federation's disciplinary committee following the challenge that led to the death of Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel.
Owono and De Miguel collided during a Spanish second-tier match between FC Andorra and Tenerife on November 2. De Miguel was taken to intensive care and died the following day.
The committee said Owono had committed a serious infringement under Article 102 of the Royal Spanish Football Federation's disciplinary code, for violent conduct against an opponent during play that causes serious injury.
It imposed the maximum sanction, along with the associated fines set out in Article 52 of the code.

"The referee's own description makes it possible to appreciate the particular seriousness of the action, both because of the way it was carried out, with the leg raised, and because of the forcefulness of the impact, which the referee expressly described as excessive," the committee said.
"It is public knowledge that the tragic outcome of the events was the death of Jesus de Miguel Alameda," it added, saying that the particular seriousness of the case justified "the imposition of the sanction at its maximum level".
Owono, 25, withdrew from Equatorial Guinea's squad for their Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers against Zimbabwe this month following De Miguel’s death.
FC Andorra manager Carles Manso said on Thursday that Owono had yet to decide whether he would return to competition, adding the club would give the goalkeeper time and space to make that decision.
Owono said last week that he was living through "the most difficult days of my life", while the Equatorial Guinea Football Federation said he was experiencing profound sorrow and grief.

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル、週間で約2カ月ぶり上昇へ　円は160円近辺で介入警戒
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　１３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　１３日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、週間ベースでドルが約２カ月ぶりの上昇幅となる見通しとなった。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の大幅利上げ観測を背景に米国債利回りが上昇したことを受け、ドルは１９カ月ぶり高値近辺を維持している。一方、円は１ドル＝１６０円近辺で推移し、市場では日本政府による介入の可能性が警戒されている。

ＦＲＢ当局者のタカ派的な発言や、週内に発表された予想を上回る米インフレ統計を受け、トレーダーはＦＲＢが来月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で通常より大幅な利上げに踏み切る可能性を見極めようとしている。 

バノックバーン・グローバル・フォレックスの市場ストラテジスト、マーク・チャンドラー氏は「底堅い雇用統計と消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）の伸び加速を背景に、ドルは依然として堅調だ」と指摘。その上で、「今週はニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁やウォラーＦＲＢ理事を含め、ＦＲＢ当局者から一連のタカ派的発言があった」と述べた。

ＣＭＥのフェドウォッチによると、トレーダーはＦＲＢが来月開催するＦＯＭＣで、約９０％の確率で２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを実施するとの見方を織り込んでいる。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１５％高の１０３．３７と、２０２５年４月以来の高値近辺で推移。週間ベースでは９月以来の大きな上昇率となる勢いで、これが実現すれば３週連続の上昇となる。

円は１ドル＝１５９．７０円と、９月初旬以来の安値付近で小動きとなり、介入の可能性への懸念が高まった。週間ベースでは約１％下落し、９月以来の大きな下落率となる見通し。

片山さつき財務相は１３日の閣議後会見で、為替動向について「足元で一方的に急激な動きがみられる」との見解を示した上で「米財務省とも緊密な連携を続け、適切に対応していく」と語った。

ユーロは０．２６％安の１．１０３ドル。

ドルは対スイスフランで０．４７％高の０．８３９フランとなり、２週連続の下落に歯止めをかける勢いだ。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは４．２２％安の６万８４６７．２６ドル。イーサリアムは４．０２％安の１９３４．８６ドル。

片山さつき財務相は１３日の閣議後会見で、為替動向について「足元で一方的に急激な動きがみられる」との見解を示した上で「米財務省とも緊密な連携を続け、適切に対応していく」と語った。

ドルは対スイスフランで０．４７％高の０．８３９フランとなり、２週連続の下落に歯止めをかける勢いだ。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

Exclusive-Investors flock to Anthropic IPO but question durability of AI lead

Nov 13 : Institutional-investor interest in Anthropic’s initial public offering is outpacing the early days of SpaceX's roadshow, according to two people familiar with the companies’ offerings.
The Anthropic roadshow is scheduled to run through next Wednesday, when the AI company is expected to price the $64 billion deal. Anthropic and its investment banks are meeting prospective investors in New York, Boston and San Francisco to gauge demand for the offering, one of the people and a third person familiar with the matter said. 
The IPO drew about two times the orders for the shares available by the end of Tuesday, the first day of the roadshow, one of the people said. By the end of Thursday, the book was six times oversubscribed, one other person said. SpaceX’s IPO was two times oversubscribed by the end of its second day of roadshow, Reuters previously reported.
While that single-digit subscription rate would be considered modest for many highly anticipated IPOs, bankers and investors said demand is impressive for the Anthropic offering given the size of the IPO. They expect Anthropic's order book to grow substantially as the roadshow progresses, reflecting strong early demand, two of the people said.
